active_contact_indexing: currentNumConstraints == length(constraintForces) == 3 * currentNumConstraintGroups; consecutive normal and two tangent scalar rows
active_contact_tolerance: normal multiplier > 1e-12; reject negative unilateral normal or nonzero tangent without active normal
contact_jacobian: CollisionModel/CollisionDOFs.constraint at the same completed SOFA substep
contact_location: normal-row point support or barycentric location on current collision edge
distal_region: contact arc length <= 3.0 mm from the mapped guidewire collision tip
distal_region_provenance: Previously validated Original distal definition; G0.5 20 mm region was a broader diagnostic window and is not used for the G2 safety signal.
vector_reconstruction: For active distal groups, sum all normal/tangent J_contact^T lambda Cartesian vectors, then take the norm of the resultant; divide by SOFA dt = 0.006 s.
force_units: nominal simulation N under G0 controlled-load scene convention, not clinical force validation
primary_signal: distal_contact_force_max_N = max of all 22 substep distal resultant magnitudes within one RL control interval
distal_contact_count_definition: Maximum simultaneous active distal contact-group count over the control interval; not just the final SOFA substep.

controlled_load_sanity.scope: Validates Generic J^T lambda / dt scaling, not by itself 3 mm contact attribution.
